name: Darksteel Eye
description: Memnarch's scrying device forged with six scrying mirrors.

description_citations.text: "The Darksteel Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn restores the Panopticon and Tezzeret uses the Darksteel Eye with Karn's head.
timeline.quote: After the rise of Elesh Norn , she restored the Panopticon to its full functionality.

citation.text: "Panopticon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
timeline.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

relations.note: He has begun to build it.
relations.quote: he studies the blinkmoths and has begun to build a monument to his greatness as an artificer

citation.text: "Darksteel", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A diamond-shaped monolith in the Panopticon that views any part of New Phyrexia but cannot see Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

pages_say.description: A device Memnarch is building that will make his omniscience over Mirrodin complete.
